title: Dukkham1; ajjhattam
text: 3 Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Sotaṃ dukkhaṃ || || Ghānam dukkhaṃ || || Jivhā dukkhaṃ || || Kāyo dukkho || 8 Mano dukkho || yam dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ ||pe|| nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
